_comment: Down but not out (Battlefield-style). At 0 HP you are downed instead of dead unless the hit was overkill: past overkill x max HP below zero, or a headshot dealing headshotKill x max HP in one hit. Downed soldiers crawl, bleed out over bleedOut seconds (paused while someone revives them), and die when the enemy deals downHp more damage. A teammate holding interact within reviveRange revives in reviveTime (medics faster and with more HP). Tickets are only spent on deaths, so every revive saves one. A blast that downs you throws you as a ragdoll first; you end up lying at 0 HP with your body intact.
